title: OpenLog
description: A learn-in-public tracker: one update a day, a shareable public page, streaks and a heatmap. No account needed to start a log.

title: 100,000 Checkboxes
description: A shared real-time checkbox grid: Redis bitmap state, Redis Pub/Sub fan-out across instances, a hand-written rate limiter and OIDC login.

title: Live Location Tracker
description: Real-time location sharing on a map, with Apache Kafka handling high-frequency updates and OIDC login.

title: Personal Dev Knowledge Graph
description: A personal developer knowledge graph that links DSA, projects and learnings, with embeddings, spaced review and suggestion-only AI agents.

title: Cricket Monster
description: A mobile-first cricket fan app frontend: daily quiz, match picks, leaderboards and a fan feed.
